payload.name: Lokesh kumar Vaishnav
payload.notes:
I consider myself well-suited for this position because I have 9 years of experience in this field. I previously worked with Educate Girls, an organization dedicated to promoting girls’ education. During my time there, I developed strong skills in enrolling children from villages into schools and engaging with communities through conversations and meetings.

I also worked as a Field Coordinator for 4 years, where my main responsibility was to go door-to-door in villages, identify children who were deprived of education, and enroll them in schools. Along with this, I provided teaching support to students of classes 3, 4, and 5. This experience gave me a strong foundation in both fieldwork and teaching, and since this organization performs similar work, I believe my previous experience aligns perfectly with the role.

After that, I worked as a Data Entry Operator for one year in the same organization, and later as an Impact Associate for another year. Currently, I am working as a District Impact Specialist in the same organization. In this role, I have gained experience in fieldwork, data analysis, communication, team leadership, and monitoring activities.

My current responsibilities include data analysis, monitoring, and preparing annual plans. I also provide regular feedback on field activities to ensure continuous improvement. Additionally, I am involved in developing and supporting district-level plans and impact function plans, as well as conducting regular reviews based on defined indicators.

Because of my extensive experience in education-related fieldwork, data management, monitoring, and team coordination, I am confident that I can perform this role effectively and contribute significantly to the organization’s goals.
